@@U04752@@
hull at length, clad in the airy garb of Heaven, and show himself in youthful strength. Kind Lady, allow me to instruct him, blinded still by the dawning day.

@@U04754@@
Then soar to higher spheres! Conduct him! Sensing you, he'll know the way.

@@U04756@@
(Prostrate in adoration.)

@@U04757@@
Penitents, look up and see Her fair redeeming face, Regenerating you and me With her kind saving grace! Let every noble mind be seen Serving you alone, Virgin, Mother, Heaven’s Queen, Goddess on your throne!

@@U04759@@
All things destructible Are but a parable; All things ineluctable, The undeclarable, Here they are seen, Here they are action; The Eternal-Feminine Leads to perfection.
translation:
@@U04752@@
船体终于披上了天堂的轻装，展现出青春的力量。仁慈的女士，请允许我指导他，他仍然被黎明蒙蔽了双眼。

@@U04754@@
然后飞向更高的境界！指挥他！感觉到你，他就会认路。

@@U04756@@
（顶礼膜拜。）

@@U04757@@
忏悔者，抬头看看她美丽的救赎面容，用她仁慈的救赎恩典重生你和我！让每一个高贵的心灵都在为您服务，圣母、母亲、天后、宝座上的女神！

@@U04759@@
万物皆可毁灭，不过是一个寓言；一切不可避免的事情，无法宣布的事情，在这里它们被看到，它们在这里被行动；永恒的女性导向完美。
